rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" autoreconf -v -fi
if [ "`bh_os_bits $AELTRA_HOST_TYPE`" = "32" ]; then export TIME_T_32_BIT_OK=yes fi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --libexecdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-nls
rules.install:
for pkg in coreutils join; do install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$pkg" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$pkg/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$pkg/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin" done
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/coreutils" install
for prog in kill hostname uptime; do rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/coreutils/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/$prog" done
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/coreutils/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin" mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/coreutils/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/chroot" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/coreutils/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/chroot"
# we need join to make gnulib work, so put it in a separate package mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/coreutils/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/join" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/join/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/join"
